Package index

Variable selection

Search over variable subsets to maximize an information criterion. This is how you will usually use the package.

GICSelection()
GIC-Based Variable Selection
GICSelectionBoltzmann()
GIC-Based Variable Selection Using Boltzmann Machine

Information criteria

AIC, BIC, EBIC, GIC2–GIC6 and related criteria. Pass the name of a criterion (and of its _short version) to GICSelection(), or call these functions directly to score a single model.

Information Criterion Calculations via Julia

Simulation and link transforms

Simulate responses from a linear predictor, map responses to the linear-predictor scale, and generate sparse coefficient vectors. All common GLM families are supported.

LP_to_Y()
Transform Linear Predictor to Response
Y_to_LP()
Transform Outcome to Linear Predictor
Generate_Beta()
Generate Sparse Coefficient Vector

Estimation

Estimate the coefficients of a selected model.

Beta_estimate()
Coefficient Estimation via Julia

install_julia_packages()
